title: Website Development & Redesign
description: Website builds and redesigns with accessible page structure, practical content workflows, technical SEO foundations, and a documented handoff from JustinJ Industries.
intro: Build a useful website around what visitors need to understand and do. JustinJ Industries connects page structure, implementation, accessibility, and the practical details of keeping a site current.
fit: For a new business site, a focused redesign, or an existing site whose content and visitor paths have become difficult to maintain.
deliverables: A page and content plan tied to the agreed visitor journeys.
Responsive implementation with semantic structure, keyboard access, visible focus, and clear form states.
Page titles, descriptions, canonical URLs, and an indexable sitemap appropriate to the agreed scope.
A review record, deployment notes, and a practical maintenance handoff.
process: Review the existing site, content, hosting, and priorities.
Agree the pages, design direction, platform, inputs, and acceptance criteria.
Build and review across desktop and mobile, then document the agreed release.
prepare: Share the current URL, the pages you need, examples of visitor tasks, and any platform or hosting constraints. Avoid sending passwords or private customer information.
boundary: Copywriting, CMS work, migrations, integrations, hosting, and ongoing updates depend on the written scope. Accessibility conformance should be validated for each project’s scope, content, and platform.

title: Analytics & Tagging Implementation
description: GA4 and GTM implementation, tagging QA, consent-aware measurement planning, and Looker Studio reporting with documented validation from JustinJ Industries.
intro: Make measurement understandable and testable. JustinJ Industries helps connect website interactions to an agreed measurement plan, with clear event definitions and a record of what was validated.
fit: For teams preparing an implementation, troubleshooting inconsistent events, or reviewing whether existing reporting reflects the actions they actually need to understand.
deliverables: A measurement plan with agreed events, parameters, and acceptance criteria.
GA4 and GTM configuration or a review of an existing implementation, according to scope.
Consent and data-handling considerations documented alongside the tagging design.
QA evidence, known limitations, and implementation or reporting handoff notes.
process: Review business questions, the site, existing tags, consent behavior, and access requirements.
Define events and exclusions before configuration, including what must never enter analytics.
Validate agreed journeys, compare expected and observed behavior, and document the result.
prepare: Share the site URL, the questions reporting should answer, and the tools already in use. Access should be granted through the relevant platform; do not send account passwords or customer records.
boundary: Server-side tagging, Adobe Analytics or AEP support, Looker Studio dashboards, and complex integrations are scoped separately. A button click does not by itself establish a qualified lead, completed sale, or connected phone call.

title: WordPress & Craft CMS Support
description: WordPress and Craft CMS implementation support, content-template improvements, maintenance review, QA, and practical editor documentation from JustinJ Industries.
intro: Keep the publishing workflow practical for the people who use it. JustinJ Industries supports WordPress and Craft CMS work with attention to templates, content structure, testing, and clear handoff notes.
fit: For an existing CMS site that needs a defined improvement, a clearer editing workflow, or a reviewed maintenance and support plan.
deliverables: A review of the relevant templates, content model, editor workflow, and dependencies.
Scoped template, layout, or content workflow improvements using the existing platform.
Testing of the agreed editor and visitor journeys, with a staging and rollback plan where available.
Editor guidance, a change record, and a list of remaining maintenance considerations.
process: Confirm the CMS version, hosting, backup process, access, and the specific issue or workflow.
Agree a bounded change and a safe review environment before implementation.
Test the change, review it with the owner, and document deployment and ongoing responsibilities.
prepare: Share the public URL, CMS, hosting arrangement, and a description of the workflow or issue. For Craft inquiries, select WordPress support in the form and identify Craft in your message. Do not send credentials through the contact form.
boundary: Plugin or module licenses, hosting, emergency response, migrations, and ongoing maintenance require an agreed scope. No uptime, security certification, or unsupported platform compatibility is implied.
